gbm_population_evidence.quote: The type and grade of glioma to follow the 2021 WHO Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System, allowing Grade III and IV gliomas.
To assess overall survival following 186RNL in patients with bevacizumab naïve recurrent glioblastoma following treatment with a second administration of 186RNL.

gbm_population_flag.reason: Conditions say only 'Glioma'; eligibility allows WHO grade III/IV glioma; glioblastoma named in keywords and outcomes, not in conditions/inclusion criteria.

candidate_evidence.quote: This Phase I clinical study evaluates a single dose of 186RNL (radionuclide clinical study drug) administered through a convection enhanced delivery catheter (CED catheter)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients must have malignant glioma that has progressed on or after standard treatment (surgery, radiotherapy, and/or chemotherapy)

role_evidence.quote: Each participant will receive a single administration of 186RNL. The proposed dose is up to 8.8 mL as a single administration with an administered dose of 22.3 mCi.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational rhenium-186 nanoliposome radiopharmaceutical (locoregional brachytherapy-like; INN possibly rhenium (186Re) obisbemeda)

flag.reason: Formulation flag: delivered by convection-enhanced delivery; nanoliposome is the product itself, so new_route vs none is debatable.

coder_notes: Single-arm retreatment study in patients previously treated with 186RNL. Eligibility cites WHO 2021 (CNS5) classification but does not name glioblastoma or require IDH-wildtype, hence cns5 unclear. Lead sponsor Cerenome.
